# Saturday workshop

😀 The volunteers arrive at nine. Their going to be late if the bridge remains closed, so we have left a second set of keys with the caretaker. Your going to be welcomed at either entrance. The morning session covers simple repairs, and the afternoon is reserved for questions. Its going to be useful for anyone who has never opened a tool box.

## Before people arrive

Please check teh printed list against the booking sheet. We need an uniform sign for each room so that visitors can find the right group. The spare chairs is in the cupboard beside the sink. We have already counted the cups, but we still need to carry water upstairs. There are two large jugs on the shelf.

- Put the the pencils beside the blank forms.
- Leave the fire exit clear.
- Keep each visitor's contact details inside the closed folder.

The **recieve** label on the old tray needs replacing. The online [booking guide](https://example.org/teh/recieve) has the correct room numbers. Its address is printed on the welcome card. Do not copy the example below into that card; it is a deliberately incorrect test string.

```text
Their going to be late. teh recieve
```

## Afterwards

Their going to be thanked surprised the helpers. Your running today worried nobody, because the paths were dry. Their going home was expected. We should leave these sentences as they stand in the reflection exercise. At the end of the day, ask each group what it learned and record one change for next month.
